# Cold War Project: flag (coat of arms) triggers for the CWP government types.
# cwp_coa_*_trigger take country scope; the cwp_coa_def_*_flag_trigger versions take the scopes of a
# flag_definition trigger (root = country definition, scope:actor = the country), like vanilla's
# coa_def_*_flag_trigger in 00_coa_triggers.txt. Used by common/flag_definitions/zzz_cwp_1946_flag_definitions.txt
# (generated by tools/flags/gen_flags.py, see docs/agents/areas/flags.md).
# Government types are defined in common/government_types/cwp_000_cold_war_regimes.txt and cwp_00_council_republics.txt.

### scope is COUNTRY ###

# Consolidated communist one-party state ("people's republic"), including the Soviet Union
cwp_coa_peoples_republic_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_government_type = gov_cwp_peoples_republic
		has_government_type = gov_council_single_party_state
		has_government_type = gov_council_dictatorship
		has_government_type = gov_soviet_dictatorship
		has_government_type = gov_soviet_single_party_state
	}
}

# Communist-led bloc regime before consolidation ("people's democracy", Eastern Europe 1945-48)
cwp_coa_peoples_democracy_trigger = {
	has_government_type = gov_cwp_peoples_democracy
}

cwp_coa_islamic_republic_trigger = {
	has_government_type = gov_cwp_islamic_republic
}

cwp_coa_islamic_emirate_trigger = {
	has_government_type = gov_cwp_islamic_emirate
}

cwp_coa_islamic_theocracy_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_government_type = gov_cwp_islamic_republic
		has_government_type = gov_cwp_islamic_emirate
	}
}

cwp_coa_military_rule_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_government_type = gov_junta
		has_government_type = gov_military_dictatorship
	}
}

cwp_coa_minority_rule_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_government_type = gov_cwp_minority_rule_republic
		has_government_type = gov_cwp_minority_rule_dominion
	}
}

cwp_coa_corporate_state_trigger = {
	has_government_type = gov_corporate_state
}

# Republic that is not communist (no council republic law): the national republic flags.
cwp_coa_national_republic_trigger = {
	coa_republic_trigger = yes
	NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
}

# National republic with universal suffrage and no military rule.
cwp_coa_democratic_republic_trigger = {
	cwp_coa_national_republic_trigger = yes
	has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
	cwp_coa_military_rule_trigger = no
}

# National republic under one-man, one-party or military rule.
cwp_coa_republican_dictatorship_trigger = {
	cwp_coa_national_republic_trigger = yes
	OR = {
		coa_dictatorship_trigger = yes
		cwp_coa_military_rule_trigger = yes
	}
}

# Federation of Arab Republics (1972-77): Egypt, Libya and Syria all exist as non-communist
# republics in one power bloc. Used by the three tags' own lists.
cwp_coa_federation_of_arab_republics_trigger = {
	cwp_coa_national_republic_trigger = yes
	exists = c:EGY
	exists = c:LBY
	exists = c:SYR
	c:EGY ?= {
		cwp_coa_national_republic_trigger = yes
		is_in_same_power_bloc = c:LBY
		is_in_same_power_bloc = c:SYR
	}
	c:LBY ?= { cwp_coa_national_republic_trigger = yes }
	c:SYR ?= { cwp_coa_national_republic_trigger = yes }
}

### scope is COUNTRY DEFINITION ###

cwp_coa_def_peoples_republic_flag_trigger = {
	exists = scope:actor
	scope:actor ?= { cwp_coa_peoples_republic_trigger = yes }
}

cwp_coa_def_peoples_democracy_flag_trigger = {
	exists = scope:actor
	scope:actor ?= { cwp_coa_peoples_democracy_trigger = yes }
}

cwp_coa_def_islamic_republic_flag_trigger = {
	exists = scope:actor
	scope:actor ?= { cwp_coa_islamic_republic_trigger = yes }
}

}

	scope:actor ?= { cwp_coa_islamic_theocracy_trigger = yes }
}

cwp_coa_def_military_rule_flag_trigger = {
	exists = scope:actor
	scope:actor ?= { cwp_coa_military_rule_trigger = yes }
}

cwp_coa_def_minority_rule_flag_trigger = {
	exists = scope:actor
	scope:actor ?= { cwp_coa_minority_rule_trigger = yes }
}

cwp_coa_def_corporate_state_flag_trigger = {
	exists = scope:actor
	scope:actor ?= { cwp_coa_corporate_state_trigger = yes }
}

cwp_coa_def_national_republic_flag_trigger = {
	exists = scope:actor
	scope:actor ?= { cwp_coa_national_republic_trigger = yes }
}

cwp_coa_def_democratic_republic_flag_trigger = {
	exists = scope:actor
	scope:actor ?= { cwp_coa_democratic_republic_trigger = yes }
}

cwp_coa_def_republican_dictatorship_flag_trigger = {
	exists = scope:actor

	exists = scope:actor
	scope:actor ?= { cwp_coa_federation_of_arab_republics_trigger = yes }
}
